user.title: Add a virtual MicroGEM
user.description: A GEM 80 style programmable controller. Its inputs become switches and its outputs become binary sensors, and it gets its own front panel in the sidebar.

load_program.name: Load program
load_program.description: Replaces the ladder program on a virtual MicroGEM. The old program is kept if the new one has a mistake.

program.name: Program
program.description: One rung per line, for example: A0.0 AND NOT A0.1 -> B0.0
